description:
A focused L and N pronunciation coach, now on your Mac.

Choose English, Mandarin or Cantonese. Hear a studio model, compare a pair such as light and night, then record the word shown on screen. Review your recognized word, waveform and acoustic evidence together.

PRACTISE WITH PURPOSE
• English minimal pairs and Mandarin and Cantonese exercises
• Direct L/N switching and clear word-level cues
• Native microphone recording with Apple's speech recognition
• Live sound views and explainable feedback
• Listen-and-identify exercises with bundled model audio
• A 3D teaching model of tongue contact and oral versus nasal airflow, with a text fallback when graphics are unavailable
• Local progress and recording replay

MADE FOR YOUR MAC
A roomy practice layout keeps the target word, sound display and Record button together. Use Command-1 through Command-4 to change tabs and Command-R to record or stop.

Interface language is separate from practice language. Choose English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese or Cantonese for the interface.

Microphone access is required for recording. Speech recognition may require an internet connection and language availability depends on Apple's service. A missing or unrecognized recording does not receive an invented score.

L & N is an educational practice tool, not a medical assessment. Scores are estimates, and the mouth model illustrates a target sound rather than measuring your mouth.

No account. No ads. No tracking. Practice history stays on your device.
reviewNotes:
Native Mac Catalyst version of the existing L & N app, built for Intel and Apple silicon. No account or login is required.

Practice: choose a language, click Record, grant microphone and speech-recognition permission, and say the displayed word. Recording ends automatically or use Record/Stop. Use a Mac with an input device. Silence, denied access, or a missing recognized word shows a recoverable message rather than a made-up score.

Listen uses bundled model recordings; Learn contains a 3D instructional cutaway and a text fallback for unavailable graphics. Progress and recordings stay locally on the device. The native app uses Apple's Speech framework and does not upload recordings to an L & N transcription server. No subscription or in-app purchase is required for this Mac version.

Command-1/2/3/4 switch tabs; Command-R activates Record/Stop. The Mac package does not embed a Watch app; the existing iOS/watchOS release is unchanged.
